scope: Foreground native invitation/private join/cold-original controls only. No installed service, guided up, relay, NAT, live adapter, task or whole migration claim.
references: decentralized-bootstrap-contract.md sections 4 Inviter-origin contact invitation and identity review, 5 Seven-stage ceremony
decentralized-runtime-contract.md sections 4 Contact-invitation minting, 5 Owner/administrator/finalization reviews, 6 Native commands

machines: A: admitted original creator and actual root administrator
B: independently owned cold original person and requester; no previously admitted network
C: fresh negative-input host only when needed to isolate pre-key side effects
uncounted_setup: Initialize owned foreground daemons with separate private homes and actual direct listeners
Create A local network with its own original SSH key using public flow; do not call earlier native six test functions
Choose or generate B original SSH key only in B private fixture; never give it to A
Use actual owner-local invitation minting for a pinned negative variant if native interface has no expected-person flag
fixture.clock: Begin near actual UTC so fixed300s carrier windows are live; no backdating or TTL changes. Decision clocks and real transport time remain separate.
fixture.ownership: No daemon seed/TLS key copy, no original key transfer between people, no fabricated admission, no SQL writes.

cases.name: native_invite_is_exact_signed_contact_without_new_authority
actions: Run native network invite with exact new member label on A
Decode psi2 prefix and canonical unpadded Base64URL; independently verify exact payload and Ed25519 invitation message
assert: Payload pins current descriptor/context, actual A host, exact reviewed label, person pin or literal dash, fixed300s and bounded ordered contacts/helpers
Invitation contains no person key material, permission, lease, catalog or claimed administrator role
Before/after authoritative tables, provider selection, owned identity and authority guard are unchanged; bounded contact metadata is recorded separately
Only explicit private mint output contains the introduction; normal status/logs do not redisplay it

cases.name: private_native_join_rejects_bad_signature_and_person_mismatch_before_side_effects
actions: Submit a native-minted token with one changed signature byte through private stdin/file, never argv
Submit a separately valid exact person-pinned invitation while explicitly selecting a different locally owned original key
assert: Both commands refuse nonzero before identity generation/key save, pending request/publication, network adoption or service enrollment
No alternate/replacement original key is selected or generated to repair mismatch

Report generic before/after database hashes; require unchanged protected identity/key, pending request/secret/consent, network/provider/admission and preexisting private files. Do not count owned diagnostic captures as product writes. No private token appears in argv, URL, logs or status.

cases.name: explicit_private_join_pins_one_pending_cold_original_and_restart_preserves_review
actions: Review exact signed network/name/context/genesis/inviter/member/person terms on B and explicitly select its own original key
Run native join through protected input; retain returned psl2 privately
Restart actual B and inspect/resume the same attempt without reading the original invitation from a new offer
assert: Flat LINK_VIEW is pending/incomplete and exits nonzero; exact reviewed descriptor/context/label/person are durably retained
Request/device/nonce/secret and saved invitation bytes remain the same through exact retry/restart while live
B has no adopted network/provider/outcome and both requester consent flags are false
A never owns B original key; no coordinator or helper is required; no automatic pending path redisplays code

cases.name: cold_original_possession_offer_defaults_seven_and_selection_stays_separate
actions: On B explicitly prepare/review/sign its own original-person possession offer through native typed signing flow
Inspect preview and actual packet independently
At requester selection send blank first, then restart and explicitly approve the exact unchanged offer
assert: Possession provider reports scopes0 and root/lease/device dash; packet root_state_id/person_lease_id dash and issuer_lease_ids empty
CLI proposed target default is7, never0 or implicit administrator8; B original key is actual packet signer
Blank selection returns incomplete/nonzero with unchanged request/key and no selection/final consent
Only later explicit selection creates its exact durable consent; no provider/admission/outcome or final commit is supplied
Invitation label/person/context checks survive restart and cannot be learned anew from mutable offer

cases.name: cold_original_admin_and_self_finalization_need_final_requester_consent
actions: A actual current root/admin separately reviews target B and supplies exact pending P/H
B actual original key explicitly reviews/signs exact self binding/device finalization
Observe final native requester review with blank first, then explicit yes; finish exact complete publication to A
assert: A administrator identity remains distinct from target B original owner; no inviter-key substitution signs B owner/finalization
Concrete root/P/H/B/D/manifest pins replace possession-only placeholders only after their correct durable phases
No adoption or selected device before explicit final consent; blank preserves same approved stages/keys/templates
Explicit final consent yields actual B local application with exact owned device7 and complete outcome; A applies the same operation
Original B key stays only on B; final historical output and one actual normal direct catalog response agree with exact operation, without service/adapter readiness inference
